## Male vs. Female Candidates in 2026

The chart below compares major-party candidate filings by gender across the 2026 midterm elections.

```{r}
#| label: gender-plot
#| message: false
#| echo: false

gender_data <- tibble(
  office = rep(c("U.S. House", "U.S. Senate", "Governor"), each = 2),
  gender = rep(c("Female", "Male"), times = 3),
  candidates = c(590, 1646, 65, 125, 60, 110)
)

gender_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = office, y = candidates, fill = gender)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#9b59b6", "Male" = "#3498db")) +
  labs(
    title = "Male vs. Female Candidates in 2026",
    subtitle = "Major-party candidate filings across offices",
    x = "Office",
    y = "Number of Candidates",
    fill = "Gender",
    caption = "Source: Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP)"
  )
```
